name: APDP-DeviceAssociation-Service
description: APDP-DeviceAssociation-Service pre-associates Windows Autopilot device preparation devices with Intune. A client script on the installation media collects device-link data during OOBE and posts it to an Azure Automation webhook, where a runbook creates the association and can assign an APDP profile and send Teams notifications. An optional switch removes existing Autopilot registrations, so review the configuration before using it in production.
author: Janic Verboon

securityCheck.aiSummary: No malicious patterns were detected. The code is aligned with legitimate Intune/Graph automation practices (managed identity, Graph API usage, Teams notifications). There are legitimate security considerations: data sent to Teams can expose inventory details; sensitive data is logged; ensure webhook endpoints are trusted and data minimization is applied. No hardcoded secrets observed beyond a configurable webhook placeholder that should be secured. Recommend tightening logging, validating webhook payload formats, and restricting external endpoints to reduce data exposure risk.
